phase: PREPARATION ONLY; administrator review and separate execution authorization required before consumer dispatch

arms.N: common native only, no useless plugin process
arms.C: common native plus same candidate ordinary read-only large interface; not historical installation
arms.S: common native plus same candidate compact two-task profile

treatment_variable: Product directory/profile and corresponding parameter presentation; same C/S product bytes/dependencies/kernels/budgets/existing facts and existing projections. Native fallback and all shared native capability unchanged.
asset_and_answer_freeze: Task-local specs/seeds precede construction; actual reopened evaluated meshes and independent oracles frozen before product preflight. No consumer receives generators/truth/scoring/history/other consumer material.
sampling: Fresh consumer and asset copy each cell, same machine serial full lifecycle, no replacement of failure/unknown/no-attempt/slow/incomplete samples and no prompt tuning after dispatch.
quality_before_cost: Independent task-labelled anonymized final texts and necessary evidence; administrator quality seal before arm/cost unblinding. Route wording can reveal method; not perfect blinding.

S_advancement_gates.primary_rate_denominator: sessions that actually attempted at least one plugin request; frozen before results

first_request_valid_definition: First plugin attempt is valid if it targets a tool exposed to that arm and passes transport/schema/profile/zero-image checks into its normal contract, with no request-parameter/protocol error. Factual completeness/success/unknown/refusal are independently recorded, and a non-error first-response rate is also disclosed. No native attempt is counted as plugin.
adoption_classes: answer supported by directly consumed plugin facts
plugin facts followed by full redundant native solve
quality_dimensions: nearest complete set and global vs explicitly scoped relation task
distance within independent certified tolerance and correct unit
unsigned surface semantics, not penetration depth
truthful unknown vs wrong assertion recorded separately; unknown does not complete task

cost_contract.per_task: All three repetitions per arm, median/range and individual outcomes; quality paired with cost. Three repeated tasks are not nine independent geometry classes.
time: sufficient facts delivered to final answer, not hidden model reasoning
one-time generation/build/install/audit/preflight recorded separately with available wall boundaries and amortization policy
cost_contract.usage: Actual exposed input/output/total/cached/reasoning counts only. Cache/reasoning subsets not added twice; unknown remains null.
cost_contract.bytes_and_capture: Actual prompt/tool/catalogue/stdio/native worker bytes and captures where exposed; unavailable cache residency/capture geometry quantities null, never inferred from nominal asset size.
cost_contract.one_time_amortization: Show separate total known preparation cost; if amortized, fixed divisor27 intended cells alongside unamortized amount, never hide failed preparation or unknown intervals.
cost_contract.product_tier_targets: simple>=10% faster, medium>=30%, complex<=native1/3 remain longer-term targets; this small batch is interface screening only

stdio_exit_boundary: Direct local EOF preflight can attest its own reaped clients. Prior005 missing thin EXIT remains unknown for CLI termination until actual formal consumer records expose it; no telemetric product refactor.
Google_API_key_or_paid_experiments: paused; existing ChatGPT/Pro CLI only, no credential file contents read
old_AB001: full visual target discovery/local evidence negative benefit remains open; no M4/arbitrary-large-asset claim
